conversation.user: Tell me about Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science, in two sentences.
conversation.advisor: Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science is a four-year, full-time joint UBC/BCIT Bachelor of Science delivered in person at UBC Vancouver and BCIT’s Burnaby Campus. The curriculum combines courses such as BIOC 203 – Fundamentals of Biochemistry and FSCT 7320 – Introduction to Forensic Science; see the [program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/combined-honours-in-biochemistry-and-forensic-science-bachelor-of-science-full-time-9940bsc/).
